## ✦ Description
Summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## ✦ Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## ✦ Architectural Invariants Verification
- [ ] **Deterministic Offline First**: Deterministic core operations continue to work 100% offline.
- [ ] **Zero-Knowledge Privacy**: No plaintext data is transmitted or stored unencrypted.
- [ ] **TDD / Automated Tests**: Unit or UI tests added/updated to verify this change.
- [ ] **Clean Lint & Build**: Passes `./gradlew test` and `./gradlew lint`.

## ✦ Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## ✦ Evidence & Screenshots
*(Attach test output, logs, or screenshots showing functionality)*
